HUMAN SCALE / Inner perception & dreams

Telepathy.

Reports interpreted as information passing between people without an identified ordinary sensory channel.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Telepathy
Telepatía

A claimed transfer of thoughts or impressions between minds without an ordinary sensory explanation.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Telepathy is a term in parapsychology rather than a demonstrated communication service. Records are more useful when participants cannot exchange visual, verbal or timing clues during a trial.

Human scale
SOURCES & CONTEXT
APA Dictionary — Extrasensory perception ↗SRI archival report — Blind differential judging procedures ↗
FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Agree on target choices and scoring before beginning.
  2. Keep the sender and receiver records separate and timestamped.
  3. Reveal targets only after both records are complete, and compare every trial.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Send the target list and receiver sheet as separate legible images.
  • Remove names, contact details and unrelated conversations from the record.

POTPOURRI / PERSONAL INTERPRETATION

Share a photograph or a record.

A photograph, drawing or dated record can be sent privately for a personal reading. Include the procedure and the question.
